{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

The [Kullback--Leibler divergence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-kl-divergence) of one model from another
is the number of [bits](entropy.qmd#def-bit) per value that a code built for the model wastes,
by the [cross-entropy decomposition](source-coding.qmd#thm-cross-entropy-decomposition).
This page applies that to data,
and shows that the model a [maximum likelihood estimate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-mle) picks is the model with the least waste.
